Hi Priya,

Thank you for booking a birthday party at Smudge Artspace! We can't wait to celebrate with Arav Shah.

Everything You Need to Know

1. Your Party Theme

You can change your theme up to a week before your party date. Just reply to this email and we'll swap it over.

2. Confirming Guest Numbers

Your party includes up to 12 children. Extra guests are $40 each, up to a maximum of 20 children in total, including the birthday child. Just let us know your final numbers a week before the party.

3. What About Adults?

Whether you stay or drop off is completely up to you. Most families with children 7 and over drop off, and with the younger ones a parent usually stays. You're very welcome to settle into our courtyard or grab a coffee across the road.

4. Arrival

You're welcome to arrive 15 minutes early to set up any decorations or food. We'll have the space ready for you.

5. What to Expect on the Day

Your 2-hour party includes guided art activities tailored to your chosen theme, free play time, and time for cake and food. Our team handles everything so you can enjoy the celebration!

6. Catering (Optional)

Catering is completely optional, and bringing your own food is always welcome. If you'd like the food taken care of, Petite by Matilda is our favourite local caterer. Have a look at the catering menu and email your order directly to catering@matildamontalbert.com at least 7 days before the party. There's a flat $20 delivery fee.

7. BYO Food & Birthday Cake

You're welcome to bring your own food and birthday cake. Please note we are a nut-free venue. We supply the plates, napkins and cake knife, so the food and the cake are all you need to bring.

8. Party Bags

Every child takes home their art creations plus a Smudge party bag with a paint tube, paintbrush, stickers, and a lollipop!

9. The Space & Courtyard

You'll have exclusive use of our studio space. The courtyard has picnic tables with umbrellas for adults. In case of rain, we'll set up food and cake inside.

10. Decorations

You're welcome to bring balloons and table decorations. We'll help you set up when you arrive early.

11. Car Parking

Free street parking is available on Union Road and Montrose Street. The Coles Local car park on Montrose Street offers 2 hours free.

12. Coffee?

Sips & Stories is right across the road for all your coffee needs!

13. Questions?

Simply reply to this email and we'll get back to you as soon as we can.

We can't wait to celebrate with you!
